title: Concept: API secret returned in a response
description: An API secret key next to its key id in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The secret authenticates every signed call the key makes, so a leak lets an attacker replay the integration's authority until the key is rotated.
applicability: Deployments that render an API secret key next to its key id into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The secret authenticates every signed call the key makes, so a leak lets an attacker replay the integration's authority until the key is rotated.
